subject: af-post
title: AF.POST.------TR.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-9 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One), first of two on book p81, paired with v2-p81-2. Accompanies Braxton's claim that 'it is possible to view the dynamic spectrum of people in a single culture as representing and manifesting the realness of affinity dynamics in the same context as we now ascribe to race.' (C)AF-POST (the concept of affinity postulation) is crossed with TR (transformation): the question is what affinity-postulation produces when crossed with transformation — the postulation being the new affinity-spectrum reading that replaces race-as-given. The subject's line runs out to AF-DY (affinity dynamics). TR branches from it and leads to RE-ST (restructuralism), then to INFO-DY (information dynamics) and SOC-RT (social reality), which carries AF-N (affinity negation) and PART (participation). DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) also drops from the subject's line and carries BIA (bi-aitional) and ALT-F (alternative functionalism), which leads to A-PR (all-purpose). A second INFO-DY label sits in the lower middle without a dot or line of its own.
